column3: NKJV has “will be with you” and “the Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “will be with us” and “Jesus Christ.”
NKJV has “that we do not lose … we may receive,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “that you do not lose … you may receive.”
NKJV has “Whoever transgresses,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Whoever goes ahead.”
